title: Market Regulation, Cycles, and Growth Dynamics in a Monetary Union
title_zh: 货币联盟中的市场监管、周期与增长动态
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We build a two‐country currency union dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with endogenous growth to assess the role of product market regulation (PMR) and labor market regulation (LMR) for growth and the adjustment to shocks. We show that with endogenous growth, there is no reason to expect real income convergence. Large shocks can lead to permanent changes of output and real exchange rates. Differences are exacerbated by different PMR and LMR. Less regulated economies have higher trend growth and recover faster from negative shocks. Results are consistent with higher inflation, lower employment, and disappointing total factor productivity (TFP) growth rates experienced in more regulated euro area members.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含内生增长的两国货币联盟动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，以评估产品市场监管（PMR）和劳动力市场监管（LMR）对经济增长及冲击调整的作用。研究表明，在内生增长条件下，实际收入趋同并无必然性。大规模冲击可能导致产出与实际汇率的永久性变化。不同的产品市场监管与劳动力市场监管会加剧这种差异。监管程度较低的经济体具有更高的趋势增长率，且能从负面冲击中更快恢复。这一结果与监管更严格的欧元区成员国所经历的高通胀、低就业以及令人失望的全要素生产率（TFP）增长率表现相一致。

title: DP207 Unemployment in Interwar Britain: Dole or Doldrums?
title_zh: DP207 两次世界大战期间英国的失业：救济金还是萧条？
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Dennis Snower, Mike Orszag, Martim Leitao, Jaime Montana 等
official: 官方在线 1987-11-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper employs a microeconomic cross-section, a sub-sample of some 2,400 adult males drawn from the New Survey of London Life and Labour, conducted between 1928 and 1931. I use this data to analyse the relationship between unemployment benefits and unemployment status. I find a generally positive association between the incidence of unemployment and the estimated benefit/wage ratio, but this relationship is significant only in the case of secondary workers. Survey data suggest that insurance benefits made only a small contribution to interwar unemployment.
abstract_zh: 本文采用微观经济截面数据，样本选自1928年至1931年间开展的《伦敦生活与劳动新调查》中约2400名成年男性子样本。利用该数据，我分析了失业救济金与失业状态之间的关系。研究发现，失业发生率与估算的救济金/工资比率总体呈正相关，但这种关系仅在次要劳动力群体中具有统计显著性。调查数据表明，保险救济金对两次世界大战期间的失业问题仅起到微小作用。

title: The Information Channel of Asset Purchases
title_zh: 资产购买的信息渠道
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study central bank asset purchases (APs) in bond markets where rational investors face position limits and learn from private signals and market prices. APs affect information aggregation, altering the informativeness of prices and their sensitivity to fundamentals through an information channel distinct from risk-premium effects. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that U.S. Federal Reserve APs strengthened the pass-through of labor market news to Treasury yields. Dispersed beliefs and position limits also provide a microfoundation for the optimality of APs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究理性投资者面临头寸限制并从私人信号和市场价格中学习的债券市场中，央行资产购买（APs）的影响。资产购买通过一个区别于风险溢价效应的信息渠道，影响信息聚合，改变价格的信息含量及其对基本面的敏感度。与这一机制一致，我们发现美联储资产购买增强了劳动力市场消息对国债收益率的传导效应。信念分散与头寸限制也为资产购买的最优性提供了微观基础。

title: Bank Runs, Lender of Last Resort, and Liquidity Regulation
title_zh: 银行挤兑、最后贷款人与流动性监管
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the liquidity choice of a bank subject to rollover risk and support from a lender of last resort (LLR) and study the consequences for bank stability, funding costs, and liquidity regulation. The liquidity choice balances forgoing profitable yet illiquid investment with fewer panic runs and cheaper debt. A higher LLR penalty rate increases bank liquidity and has a V-shaped effect on ex-ante bank stability. Turning to normative implications, the availability of the LLR reduces welfare for a large social cost of bank failure. The anticipation of ex-post support mitigates panic runs but induces lower bank liquidity ex ante, which increases funding costs and the frequency of bank failure. Liquidity regulation aligns private with social incentives and increases the social value of LLR support.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一家面临展期风险并接受最后贷款人（LLR）支持的银行的流动性选择，并探讨了其对银行稳定性、融资成本及流动性监管的影响。流动性选择需要在放弃盈利但缺乏流动性的投资与减少恐慌性挤兑及降低债务成本之间进行权衡。更高的LLR惩罚利率会提升银行流动性，并对事前银行稳定性产生V形效应。从规范意义上看，LLR的可得性在银行破产社会成本较高时会降低社会福利。对事后支持的预期虽能缓解恐慌性挤兑，但会降低银行事前流动性，从而增加融资成本及银行破产频率。流动性监管能够协调私人激励与社会激励，并提升LLR支持的社会价值。

title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients
title_zh: 遗漏变量对回归系数符号的影响
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)
abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其归零的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可逆转目标参数的符号。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决这一问题。我们通过四个实证应用和两项元分析展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）

title: Private money and money market integration: The role of payments infrastructure in nineteenth‐century Switzerland
title_zh: 私人货币与货币市场一体化：19世纪瑞士支付基础设施的作用
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.
abstract_zh: 利用1846至1893年间瑞士六座城市新收集的贴现率数据，我们发现在30年轻度监管的自由银行时期，市场一体化程度并未增强。我们将此归因于两个结构性问题：银行有动机通过保护本地垄断或组建卡特尔来抵御竞争对手，且始终存在银行券不被按面值接受或兑换的风险（该风险因银行而异）。我们采用新颖的反事实分析方法表明，这些问题加剧了贴现率离散程度，并据此论证：支付基础设施的公共监管对于货币市场一体化具有必要性。

title: Demographic Changes and Neutral Interest Rates: Evidence from theWorld's Fastest-Aging Economy
title_zh: 人口变化与中性利率：来自全球最快老龄化经济体的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper estimates Korea's long-run real neutral interest rate and quantifies the structural forces behind its decline since 1990. Using semiannual data for 12 advanced economies over 1990-2024, we estimate a cross-country panel state-space model that separates country-specific productivity and demographic trends from common global components. Korea's neutral rate falls from about 1.6% in 1990 to roughly 0.7% in 2024. The model attributes this decline mainly to slower trend productivity growth, the post-2014 reversal in the working-age population share, and spillovers from major advanced economies. Safe-asset market forces also contribute, but supply and demand effects partly offset each other. Counterfactual simulations suggest that removing global spillovers would raise the 2024 estimate by about 0.6 percentage points, while holding the working-age share at its 2014 level would raise it by about 0.5 percentage points. Conditional demographic scenarios imply continued downward pressure absent offsetting structural changes, highlighting implications for monetary policy space.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了韩国的长期实际中性利率，并量化了1990年以来其下降背后的结构性因素。利用1990-2024年间12个发达经济体的半年度数据，我们估计了一个跨国面板状态空间模型，该模型将国家特定的生产率和人口趋势与共同的全球成分分离开来。韩国的中性利率从1990年的约1.6%下降至2024年的约0.7%。模型将这一下降主要归因于趋势生产率增长放缓、2014年后劳动年龄人口占比的逆转以及主要发达经济体的溢出效应。安全资产市场力量也起到一定作用，但供给和需求效应部分相互抵消。反事实模拟表明，消除全球溢出效应将使2024年的估计值提高约0.6个百分点，而将劳动年龄人口占比维持在2014年水平则会使估计值提高约0.5个百分点。条件性人口情景表明，若无抵消性结构变化，下行压力将持续存在，这对货币政策空间具有重要启示。

title: DP21645 Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
title_zh: DP21645 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给
authors: Fabian Kindermann, Sebastian Kunz, Manuel Pannier, Karoline Ströhlein, Fabian Kindermann; Sebastian Kunz; Manuel Pannier; Karoline Ströhlein
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1,200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of -0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于养老金收入如何影响退休后劳动供给的因果证据。我们利用德国劳动收入养老金补贴（Grundrente）的引入，该政策永久性地提高了缴费年限长且终身收入相对较低的退休人员的养老金收入。这项改革在非劳动收入中产生了外生变化，且未造成额外的劳动供给扭曲，从而使我们能够分离出纯粹的收入效应。基于覆盖德国全体退休人员的行政数据及双重差分设计，我们发现年度养老金收入增加1200欧元会使无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，这意味着非劳动收入的边际劳动收入倾向为-0.1。其中三分之二的效应来自劳动参与边际调整，既通过增加退出也通过减少重新进入实现，其余部分则由劳动强度边际调整驱动。对于更年轻、劳动市场依附性更强的群体，该效应更为显著。

title: Investments and Innovation with Non-Rival Inputs: Evidence from Chinese Artificial Intelligence Startups
title_zh: 非竞争性投入下的投资与创新：来自中国人工智能初创企业的证据
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the effect of investments by large technology firms on innovation by AI startups. Large technology firms have substantial advantages in data, a key non-rival input for developing AI technology. We assemble a unique dataset containing approximately 9,800 AI-inventing startups in China. Using a triple-differences strategy, we find that AI startups receiving investments from large technology firms file more AI patent applications and develop more software products following the investment, relative to their counterparts receiving investments from other firms without data advantages. Finally, we provide novel evidence that the innovation effect works mainly through sharing non-rival data.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了大型科技企业的投资对人工智能初创企业创新的影响。大型科技企业在数据这一人工智能技术开发的关键非竞争性投入方面具有显著优势。我们构建了一个包含约9800家中国人工智能初创企业的独特数据集。采用三重差分策略，我们发现，相较于接受其他不具备数据优势企业投资的同类初创企业，获得大型科技企业投资的人工智能初创企业在投资后提交了更多人工智能专利申请，并开发了更多软件产品。最后，我们提供了新的证据表明，这种创新效应主要通过共享非竞争性数据实现。

title: The Micro and Macro Dynamics of Capital Flows
title_zh: 资本流动的微观与宏观动态
authors: Felipe Saffie, Liliana Varela, Kei-Mu Yi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities – such as services – promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that non-homotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实证与理论研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业数据，我们发现取消资本管制降低了企业的资本成本并增加了家庭消费，其中消费渠道起主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进了现有企业的扩张，也推动了新企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态变化。我们的模型表明，消费中的非位似性能够从数量上解释资源向服务业重新配置的现象，并成功复现了金融开放后全要素生产率的动态变化。

title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
title_zh: 绿色转型中的代际再分配
authors: Jean-Guillaume Sahuc, Barbara Annicchiarico, Gauthier Vermandel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The labor- income channel dominates quantitatively , generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 per- cent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了绿色转型过程中碳定价的代际分配效应，基于一个以欧元区家庭微观数据校准的世代交叠新凯恩斯模型。气候政策通过两个渠道在代际间产生系统性再分配：一是劳动收入渠道，由工资压缩和劳动力需求下降驱动；二是金融财富渠道，由资产重估和实际回报率上升驱动。劳动收入渠道在数量上占主导地位，导致劳动年龄家庭的永久消费等价福利损失高达6%，而退休群体则获得相应收益。收入循环利用可缓解这种不对称性，需将40%至68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免。货币政策对整体再分配格局的影响有限。

title: Compete or Retreat? Evidence from aid competition between China and Western donor countries
title_zh: 竞争还是撤退？来自中国与西方援助国之间援助竞争的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How Western donors respond to China’s expanding development finance remains contested, with competing hypotheses and limited systematic evidence. This study estimates the effect of Chinese aid on bilateral official development assistance (ODA) provided by donors in the OECD Development Assistance Committee (OECD-DAC). Using a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood estimator on a four-dimensional panel covering 31 donors, 130 recipients, and 13 sectors from 2001 to 2019, the analysis exploits within-recipient-sector-year variation in Chinese aid shocks and incorporates an extensive set of multi-way fixed effects to address endogeneity concerns. While no average competitive response is detected across all donors, we find consistent evidence that Japan systematically increased its ODA commitments in reaction to Chinese engagement—amounting to an estimated US$ 49.2â€¯billion, or 22% of Japan’s total ODA commitments during the study period. Japan’s competitive responses are concentrated in geographically proximate and more democratic recipients, consistent with its geopolitical and normative priorities. No comparable response is detected for other major OECD-DAC donors, including the United States, Germany, France, and the United Kingdom. Taken together, the results show that Japan’s behaviour illustrates how a traditional donor can strategically deploy ODA as part of a broader foreign policy and industrial strategy, while the muted responses of other donors suggest that the OECD-DAC system remains more resilient than often assumed.
abstract_zh: 西方捐助者如何应对中国不断扩大的发展融资仍存在争议，相关假设相互竞争且缺乏系统性证据。本研究评估了中国援助对经合组织发展援助委员会（OECD-DAC）捐助者提供的双边官方发展援助（ODA）的影响。采用泊松伪极大似然估计法，基于涵盖2001年至2019年31个捐助者、130个受援国及13个行业的四维面板数据，利用受援国-行业-年份层面的中国援助冲击变异，并纳入广泛的多维固定效应以处理内生性问题。尽管未发现所有捐助者存在平均竞争性反应，但研究一致表明日本系统性地增加了其ODA承诺以应对中国的参与——估计金额达492亿美元，占研究期间日本ODA承诺总额的22%。日本的竞争性反应集中于地理邻近且民主程度较高的受援国，这与其地缘政治和规范性优先事项相符。其他主要OECD-DAC捐助者（包括美国、德国、法国和英国）未发现类似反应。综合来看，结果表明日本的行为展示了传统捐助者如何将ODA作为更广泛外交政策和产业战略的一部分进行战略性部署，而其他捐助者的温和反应则表明OECD-DAC体系比通常假设的更具韧性。

title: Political Information and Network Effects
title_zh: 政治信息与网络效应
authors: Georgy Egorov, Sergei Guriev, Maxim Mironov, Ekaterina Zhuravskaya
official: 官方在线 2025-10-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the consequences of the potentially dangerous proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
abstract_zh: 为何政治竞选活动常常产生出人意料的结果？我们通过分别估算竞选活动对目标选民的直接影响，以及对同一社会环境中其他选民的间接影响来探讨这一问题。在阿根廷2023年总统大选期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发传单，内容为专家对局外人候选人哈维尔·米莱提出的潜在危险提案后果的评估。利用阿根廷独特的次选区选举报告系统，我们发现，该竞选活动如预期般降低了直接受干预选民对米莱的支持率，但反而提高了受干预选区中未受干预选民对他的支持率，从而对米莱产生了适得其反的净正面效应。一项预先注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论分析和调查实验，我们证明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，从而说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评局外人候选人时尤为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。

title: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
title_zh: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态
authors: Ufuk Akcigit, Harun Alp, Andre Diegmann, Nicolas Serrano-Velarde
official: 官方在线 2023-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates a unique policy designed to maintain employment during the privatization of East German firms after the fall of the Iron Curtain. The policy required new owners of the firms to commit to employment targets, with penalties for non-compliance. Using a dynamic model, we highlight three channels through which employment targets impact firms: distorted employment decisions, increased productivity, and higher exit rates. Our empirical analysis, using a novel dataset and instrumental variable approach, confirms these findings. We estimate a 22% points higher annual employment growth rate, a 14% points higher annual productivity growth, and a 3.6% points higher probability of exit for firms with binding employment targets. Our calibrated model further demonstrates that without these targets, aggregate employment would have been 15% lower after 10 years. Additionally, an alternative policy of productivity investment subsidies proved costly and less effective in the short term.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项旨在铁幕倒塌后东德企业私有化过程中维持就业的特殊政策。该政策要求企业新所有者承诺就业目标，并对未达标者实施处罚。通过构建动态模型，我们揭示了就业目标影响企业的三个渠道：扭曲的雇佣决策、生产率提升以及退出率上升。基于新颖数据集与工具变量法的实证分析证实了上述发现。我们估算出，受约束就业目标的企业年就业增长率高出22个百分点，年生产率增长率高出14个百分点，退出概率高出3.6个百分点。校准模型进一步表明，若无此类目标，十年后总就业量将降低15%。此外，替代性的生产率投资补贴政策在短期内成本高昂且效果欠佳。
